    prefix_sum_map = defaultdict(int)

    counts = []

        count = 0
        for prefix_sum in prefix_sums:
            if (k - prefix_sum) in prefix_sum_map:
                count += prefix_sum_map[k - prefix_sum]
        counts.append(count)
        
    return counts
